        "        ON sorg.`Sales_Organization ID` = csm.`sales_org_code`\n",

        "    sorg.`Business Unit 2` = '34'\n",
        "    AND i.`Sales Document Type` = 'YQT'\n",
        "    AND i.`Created On` >= CAST(DATE_FORMAT(ADD_MONTHS(CURRENT_DATE(), -12), 'yyyyMMdd') AS INT)\n",
        "    AND (\n",
        "      :segment_filter IS NULL\n",
        "      OR CARDINALITY(:segment_filter) = 0\n",
        "      OR array_contains(:segment_filter, i.`Application area Description`)\n",

        "    1,\n",
        "    2,\n",
        "    3\n",

        "    o.`Quote Number` AS quote_number\n",

        "    `synapse-prd`.pbi.`dbx_fact_sales_distribution_sales_document_item` o\n",
        "      INNER JOIN `synapse-prd`.pbi.`dbx_dim_sales_organization` sorg\n",
        "        ON o.`Sales Organization Key` = sorg.`Sales Organization Key`\n",
        "  WHERE\n",
        "    sorg.`Business Unit 2` = '34'\n",

        "SELECT\n",
        "  q.month_date,\n",
        "  q.cs_team,\n",

        "    CASE\n",

        "    END\n",
        "  ) AS converted_quotes,\n",
        "  COUNT(DISTINCT\n",
        "    CASE\n",
        "      WHEN\n",
        "        c.quote_number IS NULL\n",

        "        AND COALESCE(q.order_reason, '') NOT IN ('24', '25')\n",
        "        AND q.valid_to_int > 0\n",

        "converted AS (\n",

        "    TO_DATE(CAST(i.`Created On` AS STRING), 'yyyyMMdd') AS quote_created,\n",
        "    CASE\n",
        "      WHEN\n",
        "        i.`Quotation Valid From` > 19700101\n",
        "      THEN\n",
        "        TO_DATE(CAST(i.`Quotation Valid From` AS STRING), 'yyyyMMdd')\n",
        "      ELSE NULL\n",
        "    END AS quote_valid_from,\n",
        "    CASE\n",
        "      WHEN\n",
        "        i.`Quotation Valid To` > 19700101\n",
        "      THEN\n",
        "        TO_DATE(CAST(i.`Quotation Valid To` AS STRING), 'yyyyMMdd')\n",
        "      ELSE NULL\n",
        "    END AS quote_valid_to,\n",
        "    i.`Measure Net Value in Euro` AS quote_value_eur,\n",
        "    i.`Measure Sales Order Quantity` AS quote_qty,\n",
        "    i.`Sales Order Quantity Unit of Measure` AS quote_uom,\n",
        "    i.`Reason for Rejection` AS rejection_reason,\n",
        "    i.`Application area Description` AS segment,\n",
        "    i.`Plant` AS quote_plant,\n",
        "    sorg.`Sales_Organization ID` AS sales_org,\n",
        "    i.`Sales Employee` AS sales_employee_id,\n",
        "    i.`Order Reason` AS order_reason,\n",
        "    i.`Created By` AS quote_created_by\n",
        "  FROM\n",
        "    `synapse-prd`.pbi.`dbx_fact_sales_distribution_sales_document_item` i\n",
        "      INNER JOIN `synapse-prd`.pbi.`dbx_dim_sales_organization` sorg\n",
        "        ON i.`Sales Organization Key` = sorg.`Sales Organization Key`\n",
        "  WHERE\n",
        "    sorg.`Business Unit 2` = '34'\n",
        "    AND i.`Sales Document Type` = 'YQT'\n",
        "    AND i.`Created On` >= CAST(DATE_FORMAT(ADD_MONTHS(CURRENT_DATE(), -12), 'yyyyMMdd') AS INT)\n",
        "    AND COALESCE(i.`Material Code`, '') != ''\n",
        "    AND i.`Material Code` != 'HN_DUMMY'\n",
        "),\n",
        "already_converted AS (\n",
        "  SELECT DISTINCT\n",
        "    o.`Quote Number` AS quote_number\n",
        "  FROM\n",
        "    `synapse-prd`.pbi.`dbx_fact_sales_distribution_sales_document_item` o\n",
        "      INNER JOIN `synapse-prd`.pbi.`dbx_dim_sales_organization` sorg\n",
        "        ON o.`Sales Organization Key` = sorg.`Sales Organization Key`\n",
        "  WHERE\n",
        "    sorg.`Business Unit 2` = '34'\n",
        "    AND o.`Sales Document Type` IN ('YOR', 'YSO', 'YKE', 'YKB')\n",
        "    AND COALESCE(o.`Quote Number`, '') != ''\n",
        "    AND o.`Created On` >= CAST(CONCAT(YEAR(CURRENT_DATE()) - 2, '0101') AS INT)\n",
        "),\n",
        "unconverted_quotes AS (\n",
        "  SELECT\n",
        "    q.*\n",
        "  FROM\n",
        "    quotations q\n",
        "      LEFT JOIN already_converted ac\n",
        "        ON ac.quote_number = q.quote_number\n",
        "  WHERE\n",
        "    ac.quote_number IS NULL\n",
        "    AND COALESCE(q.rejection_reason, '') = ''\n",
        "    AND COALESCE(q.order_reason, '') NOT IN ('24', '25')\n",
        "),\n",
        "orders AS (\n",
        "  SELECT\n",
        "    o.`Sales Document Number` AS order_number,\n",
        "    o.`Sales Document Item Number` AS order_item,\n",
        "    o.`Material Code` AS material_code,\n",
        "    o.`Customer Key` AS customer_key,\n",
        "    TO_DATE(CAST(o.`Created On` AS STRING), 'yyyyMMdd') AS order_created,\n",
        "    o.`Measure Net Value in Euro` AS order_value_eur,\n",
        "    o.`Measure Sales Order Quantity` AS order_qty,\n",
        "    o.`Sales Order Quantity Unit of Measure` AS order_uom,\n",
        "    o.`Sales Document Type` AS order_doc_type,\n",
        "    o.`Plant` AS order_plant,\n",
        "    o.`Created By` AS order_created_by,\n",
        "    o.`Created By Key` AS order_created_by_key\n",
        "  FROM\n",
        "    `synapse-prd`.pbi.`dbx_fact_sales_distribution_sales_document_item` o\n",
        "      INNER JOIN `synapse-prd`.pbi.`dbx_dim_sales_organization` sorg\n",
        "        ON o.`Sales Organization Key` = sorg.`Sales Organization Key`\n",
        "  WHERE\n",
        "    sorg.`Business Unit 2` = '34'\n",
        "    AND o.`Sales Document Type` IN ('YOR', 'YSO', 'YKE', 'YKB')\n",
        "    AND o.`Created On` >= CAST(DATE_FORMAT(ADD_MONTHS(CURRENT_DATE(), -18), 'yyyyMMdd') AS INT)\n",
        "    AND COALESCE(o.`Material Code`, '') != ''\n",
        "    AND COALESCE(o.`Quote Number`, '') = ''\n",
        "    AND COALESCE(o.`Reason for Rejection`, '') = ''\n",
        "),\n",
        "best_matches AS (\n",
        "  SELECT\n",
        "    uq.quote_number,\n",
        "    uq.quote_item,\n",
        "    uq.material_code,\n",
        "    uq.customer_key,\n",
        "    uq.sold_to_party,\n",
        "    uq.quote_created,\n",
        "    uq.quote_valid_from,\n",
        "    uq.quote_valid_to,\n",
        "    uq.quote_value_eur,\n",
        "    uq.quote_qty,\n",
        "    uq.quote_uom,\n",
        "    uq.segment,\n",
        "    uq.quote_plant,\n",
        "    uq.sales_org,\n",
        "    uq.sales_employee_id,\n",
        "    uq.order_reason,\n",
        "    uq.quote_created_by,\n",
        "    ord.order_number,\n",
        "    ord.order_item,\n",
        "    ord.order_created,\n",
        "    ord.order_value_eur,\n",
        "    ord.order_qty,\n",
        "    ord.order_uom,\n",
        "    ord.order_doc_type,\n",
        "    ord.order_plant,\n",
        "    ord.order_created_by,\n",
        "    ord.order_created_by_key,\n",
        "    DATEDIFF(ord.order_created, uq.quote_created) AS days_between,\n",
        "    CASE\n",
        "      WHEN uq.quote_valid_to IS NOT NULL THEN 'Validity window'\n",
        "      ELSE '60-day fallback'\n",
        "    END AS match_method\n",
        "  FROM\n",
        "    unconverted_quotes uq\n",
        "      INNER JOIN orders ord\n",
        "        ON uq.customer_key = ord.customer_key\n",
        "        AND uq.material_code = ord.material_code\n",
        "        AND ord.order_created >= uq.quote_created\n",
        "        AND ord.order_created <= COALESCE(uq.quote_valid_to, DATE_ADD(uq.quote_created, 60))\n",
        "  QUALIFY\n",
        "    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (\n",
        "        PARTITION BY uq.quote_number, uq.quote_item\n",
        "        ORDER BY DATEDIFF(ord.order_created, uq.quote_created) ASC\n",
        "      ) = 1\n",

        "filtered AS (\n",
        "  SELECT\n",
        "    bm.*\n",
        "  FROM\n",
        "    best_matches bm\n",
        "      LEFT JOIN `synapse-prd`.pbi.`dbx_dim_customer` c\n",
        "        ON bm.customer_key = c.`Customer Key`\n",
        "  WHERE\n",
        "    NOT UPPER(COALESCE(c.`Name 1`, '')) LIKE '%CASH SALE%'\n",
        "    AND NOT UPPER(COALESCE(c.`Name 1`, '')) LIKE '%CASH SALES%'\n",
        "    AND NOT UPPER(COALESCE(c.`Name 1`, '')) LIKE '%ONE TIME CUSTOMER%'\n",
        "    AND NOT UPPER(COALESCE(c.`Name 1`, '')) LIKE '%DUMMY CUSTOMER%'\n",
        "    AND NOT UPPER(COALESCE(c.`Name 1`, '')) LIKE '%DUMMY SITE%'\n",
        "),\n",
        "shared_orders AS (\n",
        "  SELECT\n",
        "    order_number,\n",
        "    order_item\n",
        "  FROM\n",
        "    filtered\n",
        "  GROUP BY\n",
        "    1,\n",
        "    2\n",
        "  HAVING\n",
        "    COUNT(DISTINCT quote_number) > 1\n",
        ")\n",
        "SELECT\n",
        "  f.segment,\n",
        "  COALESCE(csm.cs_team, 'Unmapped') AS cs_team,\n",
        "  f.quote_number,\n",
        "  f.quote_item,\n",
        "  COALESCE(c.`Name 1`, f.sold_to_party) AS customer_name,\n",
        "  COALESCE(c.`Country`, '') AS customer_country,\n",
        "  COALESCE(mat.`Material Text`, f.material_code) AS material_description,\n",
        "  CAST(CAST(f.material_code AS BIGINT) AS STRING) AS material_code,\n",
        "  COALESCE(ph.`L2 Product Description`, 'Unknown') AS product_group,\n",
        "  f.quote_created,\n",
        "  f.quote_valid_to,\n",
        "  CASE\n",
        "    WHEN\n",
        "      f.quote_valid_to IS NOT NULL\n",
        "      AND f.quote_valid_to < CURRENT_DATE()\n",
        "    THEN\n",
        "      'Expired'\n",
        "    ELSE 'Open'\n",
        "  END AS current_quote_status,\n",
        "  ROUND(f.quote_value_eur, 0) AS quote_value_eur,\n",
        "  f.order_number AS matched_order,\n",
        "  f.order_doc_type,\n",
        "  f.order_created AS matched_order_date,\n",
        "  ROUND(f.order_value_eur, 0) AS matched_order_value_eur,\n",
        "  COALESCE(u1.`User Name`, u2.`User Name`, f.order_created_by) AS order_created_by,\n",
        "  COALESCE(se.`User Name`, f.sales_employee_id) AS sales_manager,\n",
        "  COALESCE(qcu.`User Name`, f.quote_created_by) AS quote_creator,\n",
        "  f.days_between,\n",
        "  COALESCE(orr.`Description`, f.order_reason) AS order_reason,\n",
        "  f.match_method,\n",
        "  CASE\n",
        "    WHEN so.order_number IS NOT NULL THEN 'Yes'\n",
        "    ELSE 'No'\n",
        "  END AS shared_match\n",
        "FROM\n",
        "  filtered f\n",
        "    LEFT JOIN `synapse-prd`.pbi.`dbx_dim_customer` c\n",
        "      ON f.customer_key = c.`Customer Key`\n",
        "    LEFT JOIN `synapse-prd`.pbi.`dbx_dim_material` mat\n",
        "      ON f.material_code = mat.`Material Code`\n",
        "    LEFT JOIN `synapse-prd`.pbi.`dbx_dim_product_hierarchy` ph\n",
        "      ON mat.`Material Code` = ph.`Material Code`\n",
        "    LEFT JOIN `supply_chain_sandbox_d`.`datamodel`.`cs_team_sales_org_mapping` csm\n",
        "      ON f.sales_org = csm.sales_org_code\n",
        "    LEFT JOIN `synapse-prd`.pbi.`dbx_dim_users` u1\n",
        "      ON f.order_created_by_key = u1.`User Key`\n",
        "      AND f.order_created_by_key > 0\n",
        "    LEFT JOIN `synapse-prd`.pbi.`dbx_dim_users` u2\n",
        "      ON f.order_created_by = u2.`User ID`\n",
        "      AND f.order_created_by_key <= 0\n",
        "    LEFT JOIN `synapse-prd`.pbi.`dbx_dim_users` se\n",
        "      ON f.sales_employee_id = se.`User ID`\n",
        "    LEFT JOIN `synapse-prd`.pbi.`dbx_dim_users` qcu\n",
        "      ON f.quote_created_by = qcu.`User ID`\n",
        "    LEFT JOIN `synapse-prd`.pbi.`dbx_dim_order_reason_desc` orr\n",
        "      ON f.order_reason = orr.`Order Reason Code`\n",
        "      AND orr.`Language Code` = 'E'\n",
        "    LEFT JOIN shared_orders so\n",
        "      ON f.order_number = so.order_number\n",
        "      AND f.order_item = so.order_item\n",

        "    OR CARDINALITY(:segment_filter) = 0\n",
        "    OR array_contains(:segment_filter, f.segment)\n",
        "  )\n",
        "ORDER BY\n",
        "  f.quote_value_eur DESC"
